summary: Loads customer events from data/events.csv, aggregates them into per-customer features (event count, total and average amount), attaches churn labels from data/labels.csv, and saves a cleaned table to data/model_input.parquet. The notebook has ordering problems: labels is used before it is defined, and the cleaning cell failed with KeyError 'avg' in its recorded run.
outputs: data/model_input.parquet (feature table with NaN rows dropped)
a scatter plot of total vs n
printed customer count and row count written

s1.summary: Sets the data directory and random seed, then reads events.csv into a DataFrame (41,203 rows, 6 columns) and previews it.

s2.summary: Builds a shuffled per-customer feature table from events, then joins churn labels onto it. The label join depends on a cell that sits later in the notebook.

s3.summary: Plots spend vs activity and drops rows with missing values to form model_input. The recorded run of the dropna cell errored.

s4.summary: Writes model_input to parquet in the data directory and prints the row count.

n1.summary: Defines DATA_DIR (Path 'data') and SEED (42), which the loading, label and save steps and the feature shuffle depend on.

n2.summary: Reads DATA_DIR/events.csv into events with default pandas parsing; there is no dtype or null handling. The recorded output shows 41,203 rows and 6 columns, while only customer_id and amount are used later.
n2.watch: The trailing events.shape line only displays the shape. It changes nothing.

n3.summary: previews the first rows of events

n4.summary: Defines build_features and calls it as build_features(events, SEED). The result is one row per customer_id with n (row count), total (sum of amount) and avg = total/n, returned in random order shuffled with random_state=SEED.
n4.watch: Rows are shuffled (frac=1), so the index order is not sorted by customer_id.

n6.summary: Adds a label column to feats by looking up labels['churned'], aligned on customer_id index. Customers missing from labels get NaN. The next line displays the mean label (0.1831), i.e. the churn rate.
n6.watch: Reads labels before its defining cell. It only worked because that cell ran first in the live kernel (execution count 5 vs 7). It breaks on Restart & Run All.

n7.summary: Reads DATA_DIR/labels.csv indexed by customer_id and shows churned counts (2549 stayed, 571 churned); the label join in n6 needs it.
n7.watch: Sits after its consumer n6 in document order.

n8.summary: scatter plot of total vs n

n9.summary: Builds model_input = feats.dropna(), removing every customer with any NaN in n, total, avg or label, so customers without a label are silently dropped. This is the table that gets saved.
n9.watch: The recorded run raised KeyError 'avg', so it came from a feats without that column, probably an older definition. Re-run to confirm.

n10.summary: Writes model_input to DATA_DIR/model_input.parquet and prints the row count (3120 in the recorded run). It overwrites any existing file and needs a parquet engine such as pyarrow.
n10.watch: The recorded 3120 rows do not match the failed n9 output, so the saved file may come from an earlier run.
